verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents API access tokens and role-based permission assignment, which together provide the building blocks for scoped/least-privilege credentials, and it also ships an MCP server that would consume such tokens. However, there is no explicit documentation tying token scoping to AI-agent use cases or agent-specific credential issuance workflows. Missing for 10: agent-specific scoped-token guidance, MCP server auth/least-privilege setup docs, independent verification that generated tokens can be restricted to agent-safe permission sets.
